app.name: JWT Inspector
app.description: Decode JSON Web Tokens, read their claims and expiry, check signatures with your own keys, and export redacted claims. Tokens never leave this device.

remember.label: Remember the last token
remember.hint: Off by default: tokens are kept in this window only. Keys are never stored.

token.label: JSON Web Token
token.placeholder: Paste a token (eyJ…), with or without “Bearer”
token.privacy: Decoding happens on this device; the token is not sent anywhere.
token.waiting: Paste a token to inspect it
token.algNone: Unsigned (alg: none): anyone could have written it

problems.segments: A token has three parts separated by dots
problems.not-object: The {{part}} must be a JSON object
problems.jwe: An encrypted token (JWE): it cannot be read without its private key

verify.secretHint: This token uses an HMAC secret: paste the shared secret.
verify.keyHint: Paste the issuer's public key: PEM (BEGIN PUBLIC KEY), a certificate, a JWK or a JWK set (picked by kid).
verify.private: The key is used only in this window and is not stored.

results.invalid-signature: Signature does not match this key
results.alg-none: Unsigned tokens (alg: none) are never accepted
results.key-mismatch: This kind of key does not fit {{alg}}
results.bad-key: The key could not be read
results.private-key: That is a private key: paste the public key instead
results.no-matching-key: No key in the set matches this token's kid

export.hint: Share what a token says without what identifies a person: choose the claims to hide.
